# A workflow step that needs plugin metadata and asks for it. Nothing here
# parses build.yaml, so nothing here can drift away from what the manifest
# generator reads. The mentions below are a comment and a message, which is
# where the name is allowed to appear.
      - name: The tag and the metadata agree
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version="$(bash .github/lint/manifest.sh field version || true)"
          if [ -z "${version}" ]; then
            echo "::error::build.yaml carries no version at column zero."
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! bash .github/lint/manifest.sh sequence artifacts >/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::build.yaml lists no artifacts."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "build.yaml declares version ${version}."
